name: selfreportle
description: Chromium extension that surfaces AI-content provenance and disclosure signals for a page's code, text and images (EU AI Act Article 50 context).

scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e/runner.js && node test/e2e/run.js && node test/e2e/site.js && node test/e2e/hosts.js
scripts.lint: for f in lib/*.js background/*.js content/*.js popup/*.js options/*.js publisher/*.js web/*.js scripts/*.js server/*.js server/*.mjs server/kit/*.js server/kit/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:conventions
